summary: Build procurement dashboards, savings pipelines, supplier scorecards, and audit signals. Enrol in practical procurement analytics training.
lede: Procurement Analytics and Spend Intelligence for Public Sector and NGOs helps teams turn ERP, e-procurement, contract, supplier, and payment data into clear procurement decisions. You will learn to clean and classify spend, analyse procurement cycles, assess savings opportunities, measure supplier and category performance, and identify patterns that warrant review. The course develops practical skills in Power BI, SQL-based analysis, supplier scorecards, risk signals, dashboards, and reusable analytics templates. You will also explore OECD MAPS concepts, the Open Contracting Data Standard, AI-assisted anomaly detection, and workflow automation at an operational awareness level to support audit planning, supplier oversight, integrity reviews, and credible reporting.
audienceIntro: Procurement analytics training is designed for professionals who work with public purchasing, supplier governance, audit evidence, or donor-funded procurement data and need practical outputs from existing systems.
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to procurement processes, supplier records, contracts, audit reviews, finance data, or ERP and e-procurement workflows. No programming is required for completion. Familiarity with spreadsheets is useful, while SQL and Power BI concepts are introduced through guided exercises rather than assumed as prerequisites. Advanced analytics topics, including AI-assisted anomaly detection, are covered at conceptual awareness and operational application level rather than production implementation depth.
